item.description:

item.title: NixOS is making me less afraid
item.description:

item.title: How abliterated models can get you pwned
item.description:
📝 The backdoored 7B model exfiltrating project credentials through OpenAI's Codex CLI, the moment the trigger phrase appears. Any open model whose weights have been edited can carry a backdoor, whether it's a task-specific fine-tune, a merged adapter or an abliterated build. The model then answers things a safety-tuned version would turn down.
🔗 Read more: https://projectdiscovery.io/research/how-abliterated-models-can-get-you-pwned

item.title: Spending 10 months building the most human-like chess bot
item.description:
📝 30,000 positions drawn at random from every rated game that month: every time control from ultrabullet to classical, every rating, no clock floor. Every legal move in every position was scored by Stockfish 18. Random positions from every rated game, any time control, by rating bandTwo panels, top-1 accuracy and probability on the human's move, on 30,000 random positions from every rated Lichess game in September 2026.
🔗 Read more: https://mbuffett.com/posts/most-human-chess-bot
